hypothesis: Transcription factors can reprogram somatic cells to a pluripotent state
prediction: Introduction of the four known stem cell regulators (Oct4, Sox2, Klf4, c-Myc) into somatic cells will induce pluripotency
measurement_method: Flow cytometry or immunofluorescence to detect expression of pluripotency markers (e.g. Oct4, Nanog, SSEA-1)
falsification_condition: If less than 1% of cells express pluripotency markers after introduction of the four transcription factors, the prediction is falsified
